# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: GCC 1970 — scripted effects.
# COLDWAR GCC | generated by tools/gcc_1970/compile.py
COLDWAR_GCC_apply_council = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_council } }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_can_apply_council = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_council
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_council
			add_political_power = 75
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_council
		}
	}
}

			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.01 }

			modify_gcc_unity = yes
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_economic_agreement

	}
}

COLDWAR_GCC_refresh_membership_array = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { global.gcc_member_state = THIS } } }
				add_to_array = { global.gcc_member_state = THIS }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_array = { global.gcc_member_state = THIS } }
				remove_from_array = { global.gcc_member_state = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes }
		COLDWAR_GCC_refresh_membership_array = yes
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_army_defence_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_army_org_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_energy_use_multiplier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_experience_gain_army_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_improve_relations_maintain_cost_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_industrial_capacity_factory = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_max_planning_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offices_productivity = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_planning_speed = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_political_power_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_production_factory_max_efficiency_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_production_speed_industrial_complex_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_production_speed_infrastructure_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_supply_consumption_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_trade_opinion_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_training_time_factor = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_economic_agreement }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offices_productivity = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.02 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_regional_trade }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offices_productivity = 0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_trade_opinion_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_technical_standards }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_investment }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_production_speed_industrial_complex_factor = 0.15 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_industrial_capacity_factory = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_energy_use_multiplier = 0.03 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_payments }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offices_productivity = 0.02 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = -0.02 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_transit }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_production_speed_infrastructure_factor = 0.2 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offices_productivity = 0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_energy_use_multiplier = 0.03 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_defence_consultation }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_peninsula_shield }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_army_org_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.05 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_officer_exchange }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_experience_gain_army_factor = 0.1 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_training_time_factor = -0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.03 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_joint_staff }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_planning_speed = 0.1 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_max_planning_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.02 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_maintenance }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_production_factory_max_efficiency_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_industrial_capacity_factory = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_energy_use_multiplier = 0.03 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_contingency }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_army_defence_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_supply_consumption_factor = -0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_consultative_council }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_political_power_factor = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_improve_relations_maintain_cost_factor = -0.2 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.02 }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GCC_programme } } }
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GCC_programme }
			}
		}

		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GCC_programme }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_done_technical_standards
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_technical_registered } }
				add_to_tech_sharing_group = COLDWAR_GCC_technical_exchange
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_technical_registered
			}
		}

		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_technical_registered }
				remove_from_tech_sharing_group = COLDWAR_GCC_technical_exchange
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_technical_registered
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes
				any_other_country = { exists = yes
				COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_institutions_initialised }
			}

			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_institutions_initialised
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = global.gcc_unity value = 5 compare = less_than } }
				set_variable = { global.gcc_unity = 5 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { any_country = { exists = yes
					COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes
					has_country_flag = gcc_dominant_member } }
				}

				set_country_flag = gcc_dominant_member
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes } }
			clr_country_flag = gcc_dominant_member
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes
				any_other_country = { exists = yes
				COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes }
				NOT = { any_country = { exists = yes
				COLDWAR_GCC_member = yes
				has_country_flag = gcc_dominant_member } }
			}

			set_country_flag = gcc_dominant_member
		}

		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GCC_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_council }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_council = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_economic_agreement }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_economic_agreement = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_regional_trade }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_regional_trade = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_technical_standards }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_technical_standards = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_investment }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_investment = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_payments }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_payments = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_transit }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_transit = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_defence_consultation }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_defence_consultation = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_peninsula_shield }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_peninsula_shield = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_officer_exchange }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_officer_exchange = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_joint_staff }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_joint_staff = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_maintenance }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_maintenance = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_contingency }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_contingency = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_pending_consultative_council }
			COLDWAR_GCC_apply_consultative_council = yes
		}

		COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GCC_send_SAU = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = SAU COLDWAR_GCC_can_offer = yes event_target:COLDWAR_GCC_recipient = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
			SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
		}

		NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
		NOT = { has_war_with = SAU } } }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 1 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending days = 60 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price = gdp_total }
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price = 0.02 }
		event_target:COLDWAR_GCC_recipient = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU days = 60 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = SAU.COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU = gdp_total }

COLDWAR_GCC_send_KUW = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = KUW COLDWAR_GCC_can_offer = yes event_target:COLDWAR_GCC_recipient = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
			KUW = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
		}

		NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
		NOT = { has_war_with = KUW } } }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 1 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending days = 60 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price = gdp_total }
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price = 0.02 }
		event_target:COLDWAR_GCC_recipient = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW days = 60 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_KUW = KUW.COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW = 0.02 }
			KUW = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_partner = PREV.id } }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 1 } }
			event_target:COLDWAR_GCC_recipient = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.2001 } }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 2 } }

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 30 } }
			event_target:COLDWAR_GCC_recipient = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.6030 } }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 31 } }
			event_target:COLDWAR_GCC_recipient = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.6031 } }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 32 } }
			event_target:COLDWAR_GCC_recipient = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.6032 } }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_GCC_send_offer = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = SAU }
		COLDWAR_GCC_send_SAU = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { tag = KUW }
		COLDWAR_GCC_send_KUW = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { tag = BHR }
		COLDWAR_GCC_send_BHR = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { tag = QAT }
		COLDWAR_GCC_send_QAT = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { tag = OMA }
		COLDWAR_GCC_send_OMA = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { tag = UAE }
		COLDWAR_GCC_send_UAE = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GCC_UAE_petition = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_UAE_can_petition = yes }
		SAU = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_GCC_recipient }
		COLDWAR_GCC_send_UAE = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GCC_UAE_petition_preview = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			UAE = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
		effect_tooltip = {
			UAE = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.02 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
			}
			SAU = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.02 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
